faces.name: Search for Dagger
faces.oracle_text: Whenever your commander enters or attacks, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a legendary creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

triggered.raw_text: Whenever your commander enters or attacks, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a legendary creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
